name: object-type-reference-test-19fd51d776/object-inclusion-with-private-members-negative-e.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: "[New expression](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#section_6.8.2)" is listed; object-constructor expressions are not listed.
## Module-level declarations: "Supports `object-field`, `method-defn` and `object-type-inclusion` members" for class definitions.
reason: The negative case requires rejection of private-member inclusion in classes, object type descriptors, and anonymous object constructors. Anonymous object-constructor expressions (`object ClassWithPrivateField { ... }` and `client object ...`) are essential marked-error sites but are not covered by the supported expression list. Class inclusion support alone does not cover the whole case.
unsupported_constructs: Object-constructor expressions, including client object constructors.
Object type inclusions in object type descriptors are not included in the listed supported descriptor members.
test_design_notes: The @error markers assert compile-time rejection; supported class inclusion rejection remains in scope, but does not make the entire case supported.
